question: In Multiple Myeloma trials where a non–PD-L1 biomarker was required, extract the biomarker name(s) from the trial name.
ground_truth_column: Is any other biomarker used for inclusion

target_pairs.output_name: Is any other biomarker used for inclusion
target_pairs.db_column: Is any other biomarker used for inclusion

augmented_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Trial name", "Is any other biomarker used for inclusion" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Multiple Myeloma' AND "Is any other biomarker used for inclusion" = 'Yes';
